section.text: Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: A superadmin can open the WebUI as another user in a separate browser tab. In that tab, the WebUI works exactly as it does for that user — their menus, projects, storage folders, quotas, and images. Use this to create a compute session on the user's behalf with the regular session launcher, or to work with their storage folders and other resources.
changes.newHtml:
A superadmin can open the WebUI as another user in a separate browser tab.
In that tab, the WebUI works exactly as it does for that user — their menus,
projects, storage folders, quotas, and images. Use this to create a compute
session on the user's behalf with the regular session launcher, or to work
with their storage folders and other resources.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user
Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: In the row of the active user you want to act as, click the Use as this user action. The action is not available on your own account.
changes.newHtml: In the row of the active user you want to act as, click the Use as this user action. The action is not available on your own account.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: In the Use as {name} dialog, click Open in new tab.
changes.newHtml: In the Use as {name} dialog, click Open in new tab.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: In the new tab, work as usual. For example, start a session from the session launcher as described in Start a new session.
changes.newHtml: In the new tab, work as usual. For example, start a session from the session launcher as described in Start a new session.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: The new tab shows a fixed Using as {name} ({email}) banner stating that everything in the tab runs as this user and is recorded in the audit log, and the browser tab title is prefixed with [name] so you can tell the tab apart.
changes.newHtml: The new tab shows a fixed Using as {name} ({email}) banner stating that everything in the tab runs as this user and is recorded in the audit log, and the browser tab title is prefixed with [name] so you can tell the tab apart.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: To stop, click Exit on the banner. The tab closes, or returns to your admin view if the browser does not allow the tab to be closed.
changes.newHtml: To stop, click Exit on the banner. The tab closes, or returns to your admin view if the browser does not allow the tab to be closed.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user
Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: The mode applies only to that tab. It survives a page reload and ends when you close the tab or the browser. Your other tabs stay in your superadmin view.
changes.newHtml:
The mode applies only to that tab. It survives a page reload and ends when
you close the tab or the browser. Your other tabs stay in your superadmin view.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: Logging out in that tab only exits the mode; it does not log you out of your own account.
changes.newHtml:
Logging out in that tab only exits the mode; it does not log you out of your
own account.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: The audit log records you as the actor and the user as the account you acted as.
changes.newHtml: The audit log records you as the actor and the user as the account you acted as.

section.text: Use the WebUI as another user

changes.newText: This feature requires manager 26.9.0 or later, is available to superadmins only, and works in the web browser only (not in the desktop app).
